title: Past Simple - Consolidation of all forms

question.en: Choose the correct sentence in the past simple tense.
question.ru: Выберите правильное предложение в прошедшем простом времени.
question.uz: O'tgan oddiy zamondagi to'g'ri gapni tanlang.

options.answer: He didn't went to the park yesterday.

explanation.en: The auxiliary verb 'did' is used for questions in the past simple. 'Ate' is the past form of 'eat'.
explanation.ru: Вспомогательный глагол 'did' используется для вопросов в прошедшем простом времени. 'Ate' — это форма прошедшего времени от 'eat'.
explanation.uz: O'tgan oddiy zamonda savollar uchun 'did' yordamchi fe'li ishlatiladi. 'Ate' esa 'eat' fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli.

options.answer: Where did you went last night?
She did not watched the movie.
Why were you late for the meeting?

explanation.en: The verb 'to be' in the past simple is 'was/were'. We use 'were' for the subject 'you'.
explanation.ru: Глагол 'to be' в прошедшем простом времени - это 'was/were'. Мы используем 'were' для подлежащего 'you'.
explanation.uz: O'tgan oddiy zamonda 'to be' fe'li 'was/were' bo'ladi. 'You' kesimi uchun 'were' ishlatamiz.

question.en: Choose the correct past simple form.
question.ru: Выберите правильную форму прошедшего простого времени.
question.uz: To'g'ri o'tgan oddiy zamon shaklini tanlang.

options.answer: We didn't wrote a letter to them.
Did he talk to his mother?
They did not went to the party.

explanation.en: The correct form is 'did' + base form of the verb for questions and negative statements.
explanation.ru: Правильная форма — 'did' + базовая форма глагола для вопросов и отрицательных предложений.
explanation.uz: To'g'ri shakl savol va inkor gaplar uchun 'did' + fe'lning asosiy shaklidir.

question.en: Select the sentence with the correct past simple verb.
question.ru: Выберите предложение с правильным глаголом в прошедшем простом времени.
question.uz: To'g'ri o'tgan oddiy zamon fe'li bo'lgan gapni tanlang.

options.answer: He read a book last week.

explanation.en: The past simple form of 'read' is also 'read'. The pronunciation is different, but the spelling is the same.
explanation.ru: Прошедшая форма глагола 'read' также 'read'. Произношение отличается, но написание такое же.
explanation.uz: 'Read' fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli ham 'read' bo'ladi. Talaffuzi farqli, lekin yozilishi bir xil.

question.en: Which sentence is correct in the past simple?
question.ru: Какое предложение правильное в прошедшем простом времени?
question.uz: Qaysi gap o'tgan oddiy zamonda to'g'ri?

options.answer: Did you saw the new film?
I did not went to the library.

explanation.en: 'Bought' is the correct irregular past simple form of the verb 'buy'.
explanation.ru: 'Bought' — это правильная неправильная форма прошедшего простого времени глагола 'buy'.
explanation.uz: 'Bought' bu 'buy' fe'lining noto'g'ri o'tgan oddiy zamon shakli.

options.answer: We did finished the project on time.
He was at home all day yesterday.
They didn't came to the party.

explanation.en: The past simple of 'to be' is 'was/were'. The main verb 'be' is not used with 'did' or 'didn't'.
explanation.ru: Прошедшее простое от 'to be' — 'was/were'. Основной глагол 'be' не используется с 'did' или 'didn't'.
explanation.uz: 'To be' fe'lining o'tgan oddiy zamoni 'was/were' hisoblanadi. Asosiy 'be' fe'li 'did' yoki 'didn't' bilan ishlatilmaydi.

question.en: Which of these sentences uses the past simple correctly?
question.ru: Какое из этих предложений правильно использует прошедшее простое время?
question.uz: Ushbu gaplardan qaysi biri o'tgan oddiy zamonni to'g'ri ishlatadi?

explanation.en: 'Went' is the correct irregular past simple form of 'go'.
explanation.ru: 'Went' — это правильная неправильная форма прошедшего простого времени глагола 'go'.
explanation.uz: 'Went' bu 'go' fe'lining noto'g'ri o'tgan oddiy zamon shakli.

explanation.en: To form a negative sentence in the past simple, we use 'didn't' and the base form of the main verb.
explanation.ru: Чтобы образовать отрицательное предложение в прошедшем простом времени, мы используем 'didn't' и базовую форму основного глагола.
explanation.uz: O'tgan oddiy zamonda inkor gap tuzish uchun 'didn't' va asosiy fe'lning bazaviy shaklidan foydalanamiz.

options.answer: Where did they went last week?
I didn't went to the concert.
We saw the new film last night.

explanation.en: The correct past simple form of 'see' is 'saw'. No auxiliary verb is needed for affirmative sentences.
explanation.ru: Правильная форма прошедшего простого времени глагола 'see' - 'saw'. Вспомогательный глагол не нужен для утвердительных предложений.
explanation.uz: 'See' fe'lining to'g'ri o'tgan oddiy zamon shakli 'saw' bo'ladi. Tasdiq gaplar uchun yordamchi fe'l kerak emas.

explanation.en: The correct past simple form of 'find' is 'found'. We use the base form 'find' with 'did'.
explanation.ru: Правильная форма прошедшего простого времени 'find' — 'found'. Мы используем базовую форму 'find' с 'did'.
explanation.uz: 'Find' fe'lining to'g'ri o'tgan oddiy zamon shakli 'found' bo'ladi. 'Did' bilan 'find' asosiy shaklidan foydalanamiz.
